name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
summary: At Ratchet's pier, Wharfmaster Dizzywig finds passage for a crate of alchemy supplies. It is bound for the Old World aboard a ship sailing to Blackwater Cove.

sections.title: A Courier to the Port
sections.body: A crate of potions and reagents waits at the Barrens port for colleagues in the Old World. The caravans that could have carried it have already left. So you are asked to bring the secure shipment to Ratchet's water's edge. From there, ships cross the Great Sea between Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.

sections.title: Ratchet's Docks
sections.body: Cargo passes through Wharfmaster Dizzywig's hands on Ratchet's wooden piers. He records each shipment in ledgers and manifests, then finds room aboard vessels sailing east across the Great Sea. This crate is booked for a ship bound for Blackwater Cove.

faq.answer: On Ratchet's main pier, Wharfmaster Dizzywig manages the harbor. He keeps ship manifests, cargo holds, and passages between Kalimdor and ports across the sea.

faq.q: Where is the crate being sent?
faq.answer: The crate of potions and reagents is bound for the Old World. It will travel aboard the next ship sailing from Ratchet to Blackwater Cove.
Ratchet lies on the Barrens' eastern coast, in a sheltered bay directly east of the central crossroads.

faq.q: Why send cargo through a goblin port?
faq.answer: Ratchet is a neutral port open to Horde and independent traders. Its regular routes cross the Great Sea and avoid military blockades and political hostilities.

faq.q: What is inside the secure crate?
faq.answer: The secure crate holds prepared potions, crafting reagents, and other alchemical goods for associates in the Eastern Kingdoms.

faq.q: Who sends the shipment to Dizzywig?
faq.answer: An alchemical practitioner in the Barrens sent the shipment after missing the departing caravan. A reliable runner is needed to reach the pier before the next tide.

angles.text: As a Horde adventurer crossing the Barrens, you can carry cargo to Ratchet and learn the sea routes between Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.
